ambient_prompt: Ayer por la tarde, mientras yo caminaba por los senderos del jardín...

doors.feedback: The rain is a sudden interruption of your walk, not a background state. Interruptions take the indefinido.
Mientras + imperfecto sets the stage; the rain bursts in as a completed event: empezó.
Trap! Without the accent, 'empezo' is not a Spanish form. The 3rd-person indefinido is 'empezó'.

feedback_imperfect: The rain is a sudden interruption of your walk, not a background state.

ambient_prompt: Leíamos los carteles de los dragos cuando, de repente, un loro...

doors.feedback: 'De repente' signals a single, sudden action cutting into the reading. Use the indefinido: robó.
Trap! 'Robe' is present subjunctive. A past narrative event needs 'robó'.
Background (leíamos) + trigger 'de repente' = a completed interruption: robó.

feedback_imperfect: 'De repente' signals a single, sudden action cutting into the reading.

ambient_prompt: Cuando sonó su teléfono, el jardinero...

doors.feedback: The phone rang in the middle of something already happening. That ongoing background action takes the imperfecto: regaba.
The watering was already in progress when the phone interrupted: regaba is the background.
Trap! 'Regaría' is conditional (would water). Describe what was going on: regaba.

feedback_imperfect: The watering was already in progress when the phone interrupted.

ambient_prompt: El verano pasado, mi hermana y yo...

doors.feedback: 'El verano pasado' + 'por primera vez' marks one finished trip. Ir in the indefinido: fuimos.
A 'first time' happens once. Iba/íbamos describe repeated or ongoing going, not a single trip.
Trap! Ir is fully irregular in the indefinido: fui, fuiste, fue, fuimos, fuisteis, fueron.

feedback_imperfect: A 'first time' happens once.

ambient_prompt: Desde lo alto de la duna, de repente, nosotros...

doors.feedback: Trap! Ver drops the accent in the indefinido: vi, viste, vio, vimos, visteis, vieron.
'De repente' introduces a sudden, completed perception. Use the indefinido: vimos.
A sudden sighting is a single event: vimos. Note: no accent on the short forms of ver.

feedback_imperfect: 'De repente' introduces a sudden, completed perception.

ambient_prompt: Cuando era niño, mi abuelo...

doors.feedback: Childhood possession is a background description, not an event. Tener in the imperfecto: tenía.
Trap! 'Tenió' does not exist. Imperfecto: tenía. Indefinido: tuvo.
Descriptions of how things were (cuando era niño) take the imperfecto: tenía.

feedback_imperfect: Descriptions of how things were take the imperfecto.

ambient_prompt: La excursión a las dunas duró todo el día y...

doors.feedback: A bounded experience (duró todo el día) judged as a whole takes the indefinido: fue.
Trap! Monosyllables like fue, fui, vio, dio never carry an accent.
The trip is finished and summed up as one whole. Ser in the indefinido: fue.

feedback_imperfect: The trip is finished and summed up as one whole.

ambient_prompt: Anoche, en la cena, por fin yo...

doors.feedback: 'Sabía' = I already knew (a state). 'Por fin' means the knowledge arrived at a moment: supe = I found out.
Saber changes meaning in the indefinido: supe = I found out / learned.
Trap! Saber has an irregular stem in the indefinido: supe, supiste, supo...

feedback_imperfect: 'Sabía' = I already knew. 'Supe' = I found out.

ambient_prompt: En 2019, durante mi viaje a Timanfaya, yo...

doors.feedback: Trap! Conocer is regular in the indefinido: conocí, conociste, conoció...
Conocer in the indefinido = to meet for the first time: conocí.
'Conocía' = I already knew her. A first meeting on a specific trip is 'conocí'.

feedback_imperfect: 'Conocía' = I already knew her. A first meeting is 'conocí'.

ambient_prompt: Intenté abrir la puerta del mirador tres veces, pero...

doors.feedback: The attempts are finished and counted (tres veces). The outcome is a completed failure: no pude = I tried and failed.
Trap! Poder has an irregular stem in the indefinido: pude, pudiste, pudo...
No pude = I tried and did not manage. The indefinido of poder reports the result.

feedback_imperfect: No pude = I tried and failed.

ambient_prompt: Cuando éramos niños, todos...

doors.text: ...sabíamos que el suelo de Timanfaya quemaba
doors.feedback: A known fact during childhood is an ongoing mental state: sabíamos.

doors.text: ...supimos que el suelo de Timanfaya quemaba
doors.feedback: 'Supimos' means we found out at one moment. 'Cuando éramos niños' frames a lasting state: sabíamos.

doors.text: ...sabemos que el suelo de Timanfaya quemaba
doors.feedback: Trap! 'Sabemos' is present tense; the frame is in the past.

feedback_imperfect: A known fact during childhood is an ongoing mental state.

ambient_prompt: Todos los veranos, mi familia...

doors.feedback: 'Todos los veranos' = a repeated habit. Habits take the imperfecto: alquilaba.
Trap! 'Alquilará' is future tense.
'Todos los veranos' describes something that happened again and again, not once. Use alquilaba.

feedback_imperfect: 'Todos los veranos' = a repeated habit.

ambient_prompt: Aquel verano, sin embargo, mi familia...

doors.feedback: 'Aquel verano, sin embargo' singles out one summer that broke the routine. One-time events take the indefinido: alquiló.
'Aquel verano' = one specific time, contrasting with the habit: alquiló.
Trap! 'Alquilaste' is tú. 'Mi familia' is third person singular: alquiló.

feedback_imperfect: 'Aquel verano' singles out one summer.

ambient_prompt: De pequeña, cada domingo, yo...

doors.feedback: 'Cada domingo' marks a routine. Routines in the past take the imperfecto: hacía.
Trap! Hacer in the imperfecto is regular: hacía, hacías, hacía...
'De pequeña' + 'cada domingo' = childhood habit: hacía.

feedback_imperfect: 'Cada domingo' marks a routine.

ambient_prompt: El 3 de agosto de 1998, en Sotavento, mi padre...

doors.feedback: An exact date and 'única' = one historical event: ganó.
A specific date pins a single completed event. Use the indefinido: ganó.
Trap! Ganar is a regular -ar verb: gané, ganaste, ganó.

feedback_imperfect: A specific date pins a single completed event.

ambient_prompt: Aquella noche en el Roque de los Muchachos, el cielo...

doors.text: ...fue claro, aparecía un meteoro y todos gritábamos
doors.feedback: Flip it: the sky is the setting (imperfecto: era), the meteor and the shout are events in sequence (indefinido: apareció, gritamos).

doors.text: ...era claro, apareció un meteoro y todos gritamos
doors.feedback: Setting (era) → action (apareció) → reaction (gritamos). Background in imperfecto, events in indefinido.

doors.text: ...era claro, aparecía un meteoro y todos gritamos
doors.feedback: Trap! The meteor is the trigger event, not scenery: apareció.

feedback_imperfect: Setting in imperfecto, events in indefinido.

ambient_prompt: Mientras el astrónomo ajustaba el telescopio...

doors.text: ...se fue la luz y él soltó una carcajada
doors.feedback: Background (ajustaba) → interruption (se fue) → reaction (soltó). Both events are completed.

doors.text: ...se iba la luz y él soltaba una carcajada
doors.feedback: The blackout and the laugh are single events that happen in order. Use the indefinido: se fue, soltó.

doors.text: ...se fue la luz y él soltaba una carcajada
doors.feedback: Trap! The reaction is also a one-time event after the blackout: soltó.

feedback_imperfect: The blackout and the laugh are single events in order.

ambient_prompt: Hacía frío en la cumbre y nosotros...

doors.text: ...esperábamos el amanecer cuando veíamos el mar de nubes
doors.feedback: Trap! The 'cuando' clause is the moment that breaks the waiting: vimos.

doors.text: ...esperamos el amanecer cuando veíamos el mar de nubes
doors.feedback: Reversed. The waiting is the ongoing background (esperábamos); seeing the sea of clouds is the event (vimos).

doors.text: ...esperábamos el amanecer cuando vimos el mar de nubes
doors.feedback: Weather (hacía) + ongoing action (esperábamos) set the scene; 'cuando vimos' is the event.

feedback_imperfect: Waiting is the background; seeing is the event.

ambient_prompt: Me perdí en Garajonay. Un pastor me encontró, me dio agua y...

doors.feedback: The story is a chain of completed actions (encontró, dio...). The next link continues the chain: llevó.
A sequence of completed actions moves the plot forward: encontró → dio → llevó.
Trap! Without the accent, 'llevo' is present tense (I carry).

feedback_imperfect: A chain of completed actions continues in the indefinido.

ambient_prompt: Mi abuela creció en una casa de piedra en el bosque. Ella...

doors.feedback: Trap! The -ar imperfecto ending is spelled with b: levantaba.
The story describes her life growing up, not one morning. Routine = imperfecto: se levantaba.
No trigger word needed: 'growing up' frames a way of life, so the routine is imperfecto.

feedback_imperfect: Describing a way of life = imperfecto.

ambient_prompt: Abrí la puerta del refugio. Dentro, el fuego...

doors.feedback: After the action (abrí), the narrator describes the scene as found: ardía, olía.
The fire was already burning when you walked in. What you find on arrival is description: ardía, olía.
Trap! Arder is an -er verb: ardía, not 'ardiaba'.

feedback_imperfect: The scene you find on arrival is description.

ambient_prompt: Cuando llegamos al faro de Orchilla, el farero...

doors.feedback: He was already asleep (background: dormía); waking him is the event (despertamos).
Swapped: the sleeping is the state you found, the waking is the event.
Trap! Dormir changes stem in the 3rd person indefinido: durmió.

feedback_imperfect: The sleeping is background; the waking is the event.

ambient_prompt: En octubre de 2011, bajo el mar de La Restinga, el volcán...

doors.feedback: A dated historical event is a completed action: entró.
A specific historical moment = indefinido: entró.
Trap! Entrar is regular -ar: entró.

feedback_imperfect: A dated historical event is a completed action.

ambient_prompt: Mis primos no vinieron a la fiesta del Garoé porque...

doors.feedback: Trap! Estar's indefinido stem is spelled with v: estuvieron.
The illness is the background reason (a state at that time): estaban.
The reason behind an event is usually a background state: estaban enfermos.

feedback_imperfect: The reason behind an event is a background state.
